description: Verify that DUT broadcasts ANNOUNCE_NUM = 2 ARP Announcements after the Probe phase (RFC 3927 §2.4, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.4 specifies ANNOUNCE_NUM = 2 — DUT must emit two Announcements to lock in cache state across the segment. A single Announcement may be lost; two improves the chance every receiver sees one. This case observes the post-Probe phase and asserts at least 2 Announcements.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 2 Announcements.

3. Observation (announcement window):
   • DUT → wire: 2 ARP Announcements   ← key check

[Pass condition]
At least 2 Announcements observed before the deadline.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_announces — DUT did not emit any Announcement after the Probe phase
• Fail_only_one_announce — fewer than 2 Announcements within the deadline

verdicts.Fail_no_announces: DUT did not emit any ARP Announcement after Probes
verdicts.Fail_only_one_announce: Fewer than 2 ARP Announcements within the deadline
